name: Runs on Runtime
description: This directory site itself — a static site running python/nginx listing repos that run on Aiven Runtime.

name: MCP and Proxy
description: POC for a MCP server behind a proxy so that it can scale horizontally as well as vertically.

name: Apache Kafka® Streams
description: Examples of logging, copying and filtering (copying and altering) Apache Avro® messages, using Apache Kafka® streams and a schema registry.Kafka Streams is the standard library to use when taking data from one Kafka topic and writing an amended version to another, in real time. It is written in Java and kept up to date with Kafka itself.

name: Apache Kafka® Streams: Anomaly Detection
description: A very basic anomaly detection example, using Apache Kafka® Streams. It checks for Apache Avro® messages containing a field outside specified minimum and maximum values, and copies them to the output topic. It's more specific for this than the general Kafka Streams examples. A program is provided to write an example data stream.

name: Inventory Demo - React and Go, PG and Valkey
description: A product inventory demo, showcasing multiple services communicating, with a Node.js web backend, a React frontend, a PostgreSQL database, a Valkey cache, a Valkey queue, and a Go-based background job service.

name: Community Event Search
description: Searches and maps community events across Meetup and Luma, with filters for location, topic, and group size. Live at https://search.notanother.pizza.
